summary: Frontend-only verification of the 'Sélectionner' pattern (top-left toggle) + top-right pager + bulk-delete across all admin lists, and the collapsed-by-default 'Répartition par nationalité' panel. ALL 6 review scenarios PASSED with zero console/page errors.

issues: One nationality value carries a trailing whitespace ('Malgache '), producing testid 'nat-Malgache '. Not blocking; recommend trimming server-side or in the /admin/nationalities aggregation.

verified_scenarios: LOGIN: seffabdallah7@gmail.com / Admin@2026! + math captcha (read '<a> + <b> =' from DOM, submit sum) → lands on /admin.

USERS (nav-candidates): panel 'Répartition par nationalité' is CLOSED by default (0 nat-* pills in DOM). Clicking [data-testid=toggle-nationalities] opens it, revealing 2 pills (nat-Malgache, nat-Algerien). Clicking a pill filters the list from 4 rows to 1 row.

USERS toggle select: [data-testid=toggle-select-mode] is present. Before click: 0 select-user-<id> and no select-all-users. After click: 4 select-user-<id> + 1 select-all-users appear. users-pager-top only present when >1 page (currently 1 page → correctly hidden). users-bulk-delete testid rendered inside BulkBar when items selected.
JOBS (nav-jobs): [data-testid=jobs-toggle-select] present. Before click: no select-job-*/select-all-jobs. After click: 11 select-job-<id> + select-all-jobs. No JS errors.
APPLICATIONS (nav-applications): [data-testid=apps-toggle-select] present. Before click: hidden. After click: 3 select-app-<id> + select-all-apps.
CONTRACTS (nav-contracts): [data-testid=contracts-toggle-select] present. Before click: hidden. After click: 1 select-contract-<id> + select-all-contracts.

INTERVIEWS (nav-interviews, view=agenda-view-list): [data-testid=interviews-toggle-select] present. Before click: no select-interview-*. After click: 4 select-interview-<id>. After selecting one, [data-testid=interviews-bulk-delete] becomes visible (BulkBar appears only when count>0).

RECORDINGS (nav-recordings): list is empty; empty-state 'Aucun enregistrement' rendered with [data-testid=no-recordings]. ListToolbar (and recordings-toggle-select) intentionally not rendered on empty state — no errors, no orphan UI. Review request explicitly allows empty verification.
No console errors and no page errors observed across all six tabs.

critical_code_review_comments: Users list uses testid 'toggle-select-mode' while other lists use '<resource>-toggle-select'. Inconsistent but matches review spec — consider renaming to 'users-toggle-select' for uniformity in a future refactor.

AdminDashboard.js is 1089 lines and hosts Jobs, Applications, Contracts, Recordings + more. Recommend splitting into per-tab files (jobs, applications, contracts, recordings) to match the AdminCandidates / AdminInterviews pattern.

ListToolbar exposes 'showPager' prop but Recordings still renders a bottom <Pager testId='recordings-pager'/> after the list — duplicate pagers if list is long; consider removing bottom pager since top-right pager is the new UX contract.
